concerns: Exposing raw exception messages in the HTTP Response payload via ErrorResponse could expose internal implementation details; using a global ControllerAdvice for exception translation is recommended.
Dynamic reference to Tailwind class names from the statusConfigs object might require adding these classes to safelist in Tailwind config to prevent them from being purged in some build environments.
No fallback UI is rendered if a chat.status is null, undefined, or does not match any of the four configured statuses.
